title: Workflows
description: Configure reusable workflows for new stories and chapters in this workspace.
createDescription: New workflows start as drafts. Add stages, then publish when the graph is ready.
name: Workflow name
forbidden: You do not have permission to manage workflows in this workspace.
noWorkspaceDescription: Choose a workspace to view and configure workflows.
emptyDescription: Create the first workflow to define the process for new stories.
editorDescription: Connect stages to describe dependencies. Node positions are display-only.
paletteDescription: Choose a stage to add it to the workflow.
selectNode: Select a stage to edit its configuration.
inactiveStage: Stage is inactive in the catalog
activeSaveTitle: Save changes to an active workflow?
activeSaveDescription: Stories using this workflow will receive the new workflow version. Existing deadlines keep their current snapshot.
publishDescription: The workflow will be available for new stories and chapters after publishing.
deactivateDescription: The workflow will no longer be used for new stories. A default link is cleared automatically; existing stories and deadlines are unchanged.
restoreDescription: A workflow with valid stages will become active again and can be selected for new stories.
deleteDescription: The draft and its stage configuration will be permanently deleted.
removeStageDescription: All dependencies connected to this stage will also be removed.
validationEmpty: A workflow must contain at least one stage.
validationCycle: Dependencies create a cycle. Review the graph connections.
validationSelfLoop: A stage cannot depend on itself.
validationOutside: A dependency points to a stage outside this workflow.
validationDuplicateNode: A stage cannot be added more than once.
invalidPrice: Use a non-negative override price with up to two decimal places.
invalidDuration: Override duration must be a positive whole number.
noStagesDescription: Create or activate a stage on the Stages page before building a workflow.
mobileGraphHint: Pan and zoom the graph, or use the step list below to review dependencies.
